name: Facet
text: Implement a system-wide dark theme by default with a light mode toggle. This choice enhances visibility and reduces eye strain in low-light environments, aligning with user preferences for modern interfaces. The trade-off accepted is the additional complexity of maintaining both themes, which could slow initial development but ultimately improves user satisfaction and engagement long-term.

name: Pane
text: Pane: The real risk isn’t just extra design work—it’s that the light mode toggle becomes a crutch for poor dark theme execution. A better alternative: enforce dark theme by default but let users override it permanently, not toggle it. Settle this by testing both options with users—if the toggle gets flipped back to light mode more than 30% of the time, we’ve failed.
